decision: Do not expand or replicate the moment-coordinate transport candidate under this recipe.
reason: Coefficient transport beats restart in both orders, but both complete runs lose to bilateral and raw-column references. Positive within-family component evidence does not establish a competitive method. Additional Fisher payload and persistent moment costs remain.
limits: One exposed expert bank and two correlated orders; no hard performance threshold was used. This rejects expansion of this implementation, not all Fisher-based merging.
next_candidate: Bilateral merging with an additional row-complement direction from the original-expert Fisher consensus, paired with row-shifted Fisher assignment control.
